import { type Toast, ToastRegion } from "@hackcove/ui-react";

const saved = (body: string): Toast => ({ id: "saved", title: "Saved", body });
const welcome: Toast = { id: "hi", title: "Welcome", body: "Glad you are here." };

export const view = (toasts: Toast[]) => <ToastRegion toasts={toasts} onDismiss={dismiss} />;
